surface: src/plate_core/what_next.py, src/plate_core/pm.py, gh plate what-next, plate_what_next
summary: Empty-pipeline what_next prefers concrete ready Feature/Bug candidates (#793): fetch status:ready-to-work then implementable Feature/Bug; rank ready_issue above generic epic; PM collect_work marks high impact and passes issue_number.
migration_impact: Agents and PM loops using plate_what_next / gh plate what-next may receive priority=ready_issue with issue_number when the PR pipeline is empty. Ranking still prefers budget_gate and open_pr. No config change required.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core (or monorepo checkout) so what_next includes fetch_ready_issue_candidates.
2. Prefer following issue_number on ready_issue recommendations when opening Feature/Bug work.
3. No .plate schema change; existing autonomy budgets and risk_tolerance unchanged.
agent_notes: When priority is ready_issue, implement that issue next (branch from release, fragment, PR Closes #N). Budget and open PRs still outrank ready issues. Do not re-request Copilot in loops; babysit the opened PR.
